name: Bagley Area Farmers' Market
description: Bagley Area Farmers' Market is a farmers market in MN State Hwy 92, MN, bringing together local growers, bakers, and makers. Shoppers can find seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from area farms. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
